partial: Naruto: The Seventh Hokage and the Scarlet Spring
notes: Landscape, shot at an angle down a manga-shop aisle (Kyoto), even shop light, no glare. English (Viz, Kodansha, Yen Press) editions fill the central bookcase in long numbered runs; the two left bays and the display table are Japanese and the far-right bay holds the Japanese Kodansha Akira 1-5 and BLAME! 新装版 1-3. Numbered series volumes carry no volume name, so each series is labelled once by its series title and the readable volume numbers are listed here instead: Attack on Titan 1-9, 13-17, 19; Assassination Classroom 2-4; Bleach 1-8, 58-64; Seraph of the End 1-2; One Piece 1, 67-80; Naruto 1-6, 72; Dragon Ball 2-7; Dragon Ball Z 2-4; One-Punch Man 01-09; My Hero Academia 1-6; Yu-Gi-Oh! 2-4; Slam Dunk 1-4, 31; Rurouni Kenshin 1, 27-28; Knights of the Zodiac 28-29; D.Gray-man 1-2; Black Butler I-III; Haikyu!! 1-2; Hoshin Engi 1-2; Case Closed 1-2; Hunter x Hunter 1-3; My Neighbor Totoro 1-4; Spirited Away 1-5; Castle in the Sky 1-3; Sailor Moon 1-11; Tokyo Ghoul 1-9; Akira 1-5. Partial: Knights of Sidonia (thin spine at the start of the Attack on Titan row), the Seventh Hokage subtitle in small type on two Naruto spines, Death Note (small text on a black spine at the far right of the bottom row, edition not readable), Pokémon (yellow spines, series name only), Howl's Moving Castle (blue film-comic spines, faint), Kiki's Delivery Service and Blue Exorcist (cut off at the bottom right), 東方茨歌仙 (a cover on the display table, cut by the frame). Left out: the top shelf of the central bay (Oishinbo by the author names only, and white spines ending in D.M.A that cannot be read), the thin blue spines next to Knights of Sidonia, the Japanese light-novel and game-comic spines in the left bays (angle too steep; only the category signs スパロボ, モンスターハンター, ATLUS, ダンガンロンパ, 戦国BASARA, テイルズシリーズ, Fate関連コミックス, ゲーム系その他 and the shop poster JOJOVELLER are legible, and they are not books), and the covers laid on the table at the bottom left.
